title: Peel, Mince, and Sauté Garlic
summary: The person is breaking apart a garlic bulb and peeling cloves by hand next to a frying pan and cooking oil, likely preparing garlic to sauté in the pan.

nodes.name: Break cloves off the bulb
nodes.instruction_novice: Hold the garlic bulb and press or twist it so the individual cloves come apart. Pull off as many cloves as the recipe needs.
nodes.end_state: Several loose garlic cloves sit on the counter beside the remaining bulb.

checks.question: Is this step done: Break cloves off the bulb?

nodes.name: Peel the garlic cloves
nodes.instruction_novice: Pinch the papery skin at the tip of a clove and peel it away with your fingernails. Pressing the clove gently with a knife flat first makes this easier.
nodes.end_state: Clean white cloves are on the counter with the papery skins in a separate pile.

checks.question: Is this step done: Peel the garlic cloves?

nodes.name: Trim the root ends
nodes.instruction_novice: On a cutting board, slice off the hard brown root end of each clove. Throw away the trimmed ends.
nodes.end_state: Peeled cloves with no brown tips sit on a cutting board.

checks.question: Is this step done: Trim the root ends?

nodes.name: Mince the garlic
nodes.instruction_novice: Slice each clove thinly, then rock your knife back and forth over the slices until they are tiny, even pieces. Keep your fingertips curled away from the blade.
nodes.end_state: A small pile of finely minced garlic sits on the cutting board.

checks.question: Is this step done: Mince the garlic?

nodes.name: Clear away the garlic skins
nodes.instruction_novice: Gather the papery skins and trimmed ends and throw them in the trash. This keeps your work area clean.
nodes.end_state: The counter is free of garlic skins.

checks.question: Is this step done: Clear away the garlic skins?

nodes.name: Heat the frying pan
nodes.instruction_novice: Set the pan on a burner and turn it to medium-low. Let it warm for about a minute.
nodes.end_state: The pan sits on an active burner and is warm.

checks.question: Is this step done: Heat the frying pan?

nodes.name: Add oil to the pan
nodes.instruction_novice: Pour about a tablespoon of oil into the pan and tilt it to coat the bottom. Wait until the oil looks shimmery.
nodes.end_state: A thin, shimmering layer of oil coats the pan bottom.

checks.question: Is this step done: Add oil to the pan?

nodes.name: Add the garlic
nodes.instruction_novice: Scrape the minced garlic into the oil and spread it out. It should sizzle gently, not violently.
nodes.end_state: Minced garlic is spread in the oil and gently sizzling.

checks.question: Is this step done: Add the garlic?

nodes.name: Sauté until fragrant
nodes.instruction_novice: Stir constantly for about 30 to 60 seconds until it smells strong and turns pale golden. Don't let it brown, or it will taste bitter.
nodes.end_state: The garlic in the pan is fragrant and light golden.

checks.question: Is this step done: Sauté until fragrant?

nodes.name: Remove from heat or continue recipe
nodes.instruction_novice: Turn off the burner, or add your next ingredients right away so the garlic doesn't burn.
nodes.end_state: The burner is off or the next ingredients are in the pan with the garlic.

checks.question: Is this step done: Remove from heat or continue recipe?
